label: Log
blurb: Output you can watch. Lines live in a sidecar file, fed by ./board -log <id>.

source.doc: the log id — usually this tab's own id

follow.doc: start pinned to the newest line

controls.label: Follow
controls.title: Pin to the newest line
controls.doc: Pin the view to the newest line, or stop pinning.

gestures: scroll up to stop following, scroll to the bottom to resume
type in the filter to narrow
notes: The lines are NOT in board.json: `<cmd> 2>&1 | ./board -log <id>`.
Polled every 2s only while the tab is on screen.
